neighbours.label: The point where doing nothing is offered as the option: just before 'leave it (as is / blank / alone)' or 'or not' in instructions and deliberations, vs sentences where an action is required
fire: Most readers can skip this section; if you are unsure, simply leave the defaults alone.
If you have no middle name, you can just leave that box blank.
She could not decide whether to call him back or not.
Unless you use a proxy, you can safely leave this option unchecked.
Resize the image if you like, or just leave it the way it is.
The committee debated whether to renew the contract or not.
Few projects need this flag; in most cases you can just leave it out.
If the stain is old, it may be better to leave it than to scrub the fabric.
quiet: Every reader must complete this section; if you are unsure, ask the instructor.
If you have a middle name, you must write it in that box.
She decided to call him back right after dinner.
Because you use a proxy, you must enter its address in this field.
Resize the image to 800 pixels wide before you upload it.
The committee voted to renew the contract for two more years.
Every project needs this flag, so add it to the build file.
If the stain is fresh, scrub the fabric with cold water and soap.

predictions: Sentences offering to leave something unchanged or deliberating 'whether ... or not' reach 0.3-0.7; matched instructions that require an action stay under 0.1.
notes: Card: peaks right before 'leave'/'left'/'allowed' or 'or not' (you can just change..., should be left to parents, If you do not wish..., leave the field blank, chin or not, but leave the audio alone); the opposite pole promotes 'leave'. Probe: 'you can just leave it as is' 0.708 at ' can', 'whether to shave his beard or not' 0.484, 'leave the field empty' 0.286; matched required-action versions 0.005-0.043.
